svg.title: CUDA k-means execution model
svg.desc: 99,968 points in 3 dimensions are transposed to a coordinate-major layout for coalesced access, tiled across 781 thread blocks of 128 threads, and processed by three kernels per iteration. A blocking copy of the convergence value back to the host interrupts the pipeline between the second and third kernels. The grid heatmap shows how many points in each block changed cluster; it goes quiet as the algorithm converges over 31 iterations. The third kernel launches a single block, leaving most of the device idle.
svg.text: HOST → DEVICE · ONCE, BEFORE THE LOOP
GRID · 781 BLOCKS × 128 THREADS · ONE THREAD PER POINT
shade = points in that block that changed cluster
SHARED MEMORY PER BLOCK · 1,904 BYTES, PACKED BY HAND
a single extern __shared__ allocation, sliced into six regions by pointer arithmetic
the δ copy blocks mid-pipeline; centroid sums come back after the third kernel and are divided on the host
